verifications.note: Article reports WBI's application says interested customers are building power generation to support data centers, and the Ellendale extension serves a data center.

records.researcher_notes: A North Dakota Monitor article from August 2025 says WBI Energy's own application for state backing states that many customers interested in the Bakken East pipeline are developing power plants to support data centers. The pipeline plan also includes an extension to Ellendale, which hosts a data center. No single campus is named for the main line.
